messages:
deploy-bot: Postdeploy smoke: 0.8% of synth probes hitting embed-route-v2 are returning 503 - spike started at +3m after rollout. Logs show probe target IP is old pool (orphan). Collecting details...

maria: seeing same in eu-west1, p95 spike ~450ms and a few 503s. not huge but odd pattern, likely stale probe registry

sam: timeline? which rollout? can we confirm if probes are sticky to vip IPs?

deploy-bot: rollout id r2026-04-22-02, canary -> gradual. probe agent reports target arn:embed-old-az-1 in traces

tao: if probes are pointing at retired tasks that's a registry sync bug. quick fix: add probe TTL and mark retired tasks as blackhole

lucy: can we target a patch without rollback? we have traffic on 10% canary. prefer pin hold instead of full rollback

maria: +1 hold canary at 10%, patch probe-registry, then run targeted synth replay against the retired pool

sam: I can apply probe-registry change. plan:
1) patch blackhole list (0.5m)
2) reload probe agents (30s staggered)
3) rerun smoke replay (2m)

nate: on it. running one-off replay against embed-route-v2 -> reproducing 503s via old ip

ops-bot: Action required: canary hold applied by @maria. Timestamp 3254330120

sam: patch pushed to probe-registry: set probe_target_ttl=60s and mark arn:embed-old-az-1 as retired

maria: reloaded probe agents in eu-west1 and us-west2 (stagger 10s)

nate: replay results -> 0 503s, latency back to baseline. tail p95 normalized

lucy: rolling the patch cluster-wide, keeping canary at 10% for +10m before ramp

maria: would like an additional synthetic sweep across routes with sticky-session flag to ensure no residuals

deploy-bot: sweep scheduled and completed: no further orphan hits. closing rollforward. recommend backfill note in release notes: Probe registry TTL and retired-target blackhole to prevent postdeploy orphan probes :white_check_mark:
